def transform(grid):
    """Overlay binary panels above and below the uniform divider; mark overlaps as 2."""
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("panels have different heights")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
